title: RecordAttachmentsPanel offers a Retry for an api-disabled sys_attachment, which no retry can fix
body:
## Finding

Observation-class, found while implementing #4684 (the unavailable-vs-empty split in `RecordAttachmentsPanel`). That card's scope was the assert-vs-don't-assert distinction — stop claiming "No attachments yet" for a read that never answered — and it is fully served without this refinement, so this is filed rather than widened into that PR.

After #4684 the panel classifies a failed `sys_attachment` list read two ways: `denied` (403 / `PERMISSION_DENIED` / `FORBIDDEN` / an RLS denial, via `isPermissionError`) and `unavailable` (everything else). `unavailable` renders "We couldn't load the attachments for this record." **with a Retry**, which is the right affordance for what it was designed against: a network failure, a 5xx, an expired session. All three are transient and a second attempt genuinely fixes them.

Two error codes land in `unavailable` that are **not** transient:

- `OBJECT_API_DISABLED` (404) — `enable.apiEnabled: false`; the object is not exposed over the data API at all.
- `OBJECT_API_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED` (405) — the operation is absent from the `enable.apiMethods` whitelist.

Both are pure functions of the object's metadata — no user, no session, no request body — so, as `packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts` puts it, "every retry of every persona gets the identical answer". The panel offers a Retry button that is guaranteed to re-render the same state, which is the same class of wrong advice (telling the user to try again when nothing will change) that `ListView.classifyLoadError` exists to stop giving. That classifier already separates the case as its own `api-disabled` kind, precisely because neither "try again" nor "ask your administrator for access" is honest for it.

## Why this is an observation, not a defect

The panel is not lying about anything after #4684 — `unavailable` correctly asserts nothing about the record's contents, which was the actual bug. What remains is **copy and affordance precision**: a useless button and a sentence less specific than the sibling surface's. Severity is also bounded by reachability — the panel only renders when the object declares `enable: { files: true }`, and `sys_attachment` is a system object, so an `enable`-block denial reaching it is an unusual deployment.

Recording it because the judgement was made deliberately during #4684 rather than overlooked, and the reasoning is worth more written down than re-derived.

## Suggested shape

Either reuse the sibling classification wholesale (`ListView.classifyLoadError` is currently a module-local `function` in `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`, not exported — lifting it to a shared home would serve both surfaces and is arguably the better half of this), or add a fifth panel status that drops the Retry and says the attachments list is not available on this object. The predicate already exists and is exported: `isApiAccessDeniedError` in `@object-ui/data-objectstack`.

File: `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordAttachmentsPanel.tsx`

Backlink: found during the #4684 dispatch; PR #4691 carries the note in its body. Neither is addressed by this issue, and both are tracked on their own.

Filed unassigned, for PM triage.
